limitations: The game city/rural/mine locators are approximate correspondences. Fitted residuals are not independent accuracy. Cologne and Bonn mismatches must be disclosed; neither is used to force a seven-pixel translation or relocate a city.

Only eight listed PRU parents are eligible; existing Cologne/Trier/Mainz/Palatinate allocations, Lippe, Schaumburg-Lippe, Belgium, Gelre, Hannover and Franconia are excluded. Not a complete reconstruction of each episcopal state.
Conservative mainland envelopes, with smaller adjacent jurisdictions left outside where identifiable. Tiny enclaves and disputed franges are not automatically assigned to the neighbouring prince.

Munster and Cologne share the historical bishop but remain separate legal estates. New Munster and Paderborn country definitions do not invent Prussian secularisation before 1802 or Bavarian succession before December 1777.

Cleves, Mark, Minden-Ravensberg and Prussian Gueldre are not unified with later Prussian acquisitions. Osnabruck, Bentheim, Nassau branches and imperial cities need their own representable boundaries; no arbitrary country-wide transfer.

No changes to Erfurt-Eichsfeld, earlier affine models, geographic grids or physical locator coordinates. Any split crossing an existing hub is handled by explicit RGB-reference rebinding, not moving the hub.
